youtube.title: Plague doctors stuffed their masks with FLOWERS 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Why did plague doctors wear a bird mask? The answer is worse than you think 💀

Would YOU let this guy treat you? Yes or no 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in the 1600s many doctors believed plague spread through bad-smelling air (miasma). The famous beaked plague-doctor costume, shown in a 1656 engraving from the Rome plague, had a beak packed with herbs, spices and flowers to "filter" the air. It did nothing against plague, which is spread by fleas and infected people. Historians still debate how often the costume was actually worn.
